## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Architecture impact

State the appropriate review level: cosmetic, single-feature logic, or cross-boundary.
For meaningful changes, explain state/data ownership, reused logic and any affected
contracts, retries, account isolation or compatibility. Record unrelated debt
separately. A short statement is enough for cosmetic changes.

## Validation

List the relevant checks and outcomes. Distinguish automated, emulator, phone and
production verification; identify skipped checks and remaining limitations.

## Release / data impact

Mention deployment, migration, native rebuild, privacy or Play declaration changes
when applicable. Remove this section when there is no material impact.
